description: Operator only: name an install's state root as its new estate (dev -> m4). With CS_STATE_ROOT and CS_CONFIG_ROOT set to the install's roots and config/ESTATE already the new name: dry-run (default) shows the record; write checks config/ESTATE, no .cutover-incomplete and row boundaries, writes <state>/estate-cutover-v2.json {estate, aliases, state_root, previous v1 sha256, copy, historical_prefixes} plus its sha256 anchor in config, then one estate_cutover row per shelf stamped with the new estate; rerun keeps an identical record and refuses a different one; verify checks anchor, v1, prefixes and later rows. Aliases (dev) keep earlier grants and cohorts valid. Not a model tool.
